titulo: Multimodality therapy for stage IB3 cervical cancer with a delayed diagnosis at 21 weeks of gestation: from neoadjuvant chemotherapy to adjuvant chemoradiotherapy—a case report

fig.label: Figure 3
fig.caption: Gross and histopathological findings. (A) Gross specimen of the uterus and cervical tumor following neoadjuvant chemotherapy, with the arrow indicating the cervical lesion. (B) Hematoxylin-eosin (H&E) staining of cervical squamous cell carcinoma, original magnification ×200. (C) H&E staining of placental tissue, original magnification ×200, showing villous congestion, fibrinoid deposition, and focal calcification.
